items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I recorded my track with Steve Coleman.

ctx.x: Yep. I’ll tell you about that date. I drove with Phil Woods, in fact the first time that I actually really talked to him. I drove him in. I recorded my track with Steve Coleman. Then I got – Steve was playing – I never heard Steve play next to me. Like I said, you learn more when you’re next to him. He played some stuff that was kind of like – not like me, but there was something there. I said, “Steve, would you come to my master class?” He came. It was one of my lectures. He was the best of all the guys I’ve…
I’ve heard that from other people as well.
